name: Utter Determination
body:
School abjuration; Level paladin 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 5 rounds

DESCRIPTION

You ignore the dead, disabled, dying, staggered and/or unconscious conditions. You are also immune to all healing spells and effects such as conjuration (healing) spells, fast healing, regeneration, and even temporary hit points. Increases to your Constitution score while this spell is in effect do no increase your hit points; at the end of this spell’s duration, you suffer the effects of all the conditions you were ignoring.
